python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys

def call(req):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "main.py"], input=json.dumps(req), capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

# Two lines same group, exceeding cap; charge_cents chosen so uncapped credits sum > 2400
req = {
    "command": "total",
    "lines": [
        {"line_id": "L-2", "account_id": "A", "subscription_id": "S", "service_on": "2026-04-16", "charge_cents": 20000},
        {"line_id": "L-1", "account_id": "A", "subscription_id": "S", "service_on": "2026-04-15", "charge_cents": 20000},
    ],
}
print(call(req))
# expect: L-1 earlier service_on gets floor(2000)=2000, remaining cap 400, L-2 uncapped 2000 -> capped to 400
# total credit = 2400, total charge = 40000, amount_due = 37600

# Different accounts, same subscription_id -> independent caps
req2 = {
    "command": "total",
    "lines": [
        {"line_id": "L-1", "account_id": "A", "subscription_id": "S", "service_on": "2026-04-15", "charge_cents": 20000},
        {"line_id": "L-2", "account_id": "B", "subscription_id": "S", "service_on": "2026-04-15", "charge_cents": 20000},
    ],
}
print(call(req2))
# expect both get 2000 credit (independent caps), total credit 4000, charge 40000, due 36000

# Empty
print(call({"command": "total", "lines": []}))
EOF
